name: control-room
zh_caption: 监听控制室展开，积分/短时 LUFS 与峰值 dBTP 读数可见。
en_caption: The control room is expanded and the integrated/short-term LUFS and peak dBTP readings are visible.
zh_steps: 按 F4 或从“混音”菜单打开控制室，播放一段有鼓、贝斯与主唱的段落。
en_steps: Press F4 or open Control Room from the Mixing menu, then play a section with drums, bass, and a lead vocal.

name: mixer-console
zh_caption: 混音控制台打开，至少三条轨有通道条，主总线推子与电平可见。
en_caption: The mixer console is open with at least three track channel strips; the master fader and meter are visible.
zh_steps: 按 X 或 F8 打开混音控制台，选中一条轨，观察推子、声像与设备链入口。
en_steps: Press X or F8 to open the mixer console, select a track, and inspect its fader, pan, and device-chain entry.

name: mixer-channel-strip
zh_caption: 混音控制台最大化，单条通道条完整显示：名称、IN/Ø、推子 dB、声像、电平表。
en_caption: The mixer console is maximised and one channel strip is fully visible: name, IN/Ø, fader dB, pan, and meter.
zh_steps: 按 X 或 F8 打开混音控制台，选中一条轨，按 F3 最大化底部控制台。
en_steps: Press X or F8 to open the mixer console, select a track, and press F3 to maximise the bottom dock.

name: device-rack-eq-curve
zh_caption: 当前轨已装 EQ，设备机架中央显示频响曲线，低架增益滑块可见，曲线不是平线。
en_caption: The current track has an EQ inserted; the device rack shows the response curve, the low-gain slider is visible, and the curve is not flat.
zh_steps: 选中一条音频或 MIDI 轨，按 F9 打开设备机架，点“装 EQ”，拖动曲线中段抬高 3 dB，再回听。
en_steps: Select an audio or MIDI track, press F9, click "Insert EQ", drag the mid third of the curve up 3 dB, then audition.

name: device-rack-compressor
zh_caption: 当前轨已装 Compressor，设备机架显示压缩器读数条与 Ratio 循环按钮，压缩曲线可见。
en_caption: The current track has a Compressor inserted; the device rack shows the compressor readout and Ratio cycle button, with the compressor curve visible.
zh_steps: 选中一条音频或 MIDI 轨，按 F9 打开设备机架，点“装 Compressor”，点 Ratio 切到 4:1，回听整体。
en_steps: Select an audio or MIDI track, press F9, click "Insert Compressor", click Ratio to 4:1, then audition the full mix.

name: device-rack-reverb-installed
zh_caption: 设备机架里选中一条轨，设备卡显示一台 Reverb 及已识别参数读数；下方是发送条，没有混响旋钮。
en_caption: A track is selected in the device rack; the device card shows a Reverb and recognized parameter readouts; the send strip below has no reverb knobs.
zh_steps: 选中一条音频轨，按 F9 打开设备机架，点“装混响”，观察设备卡只显示参数读数；再点“+ 辅助返回”建返回轨。
en_steps: Select an audio track, press F9, click "Install reverb", observe that the card only shows readouts; then click "+ Aux Return" to create a return track.

name: send-aux-reverb
zh_caption: 源轨的发送条显示一条“发送 → Aux”行与增益滑块；辅助返回轨上装有 Reverb。
en_caption: The source track's send strip shows a "Send → Aux" row and gain slider; the aux return track has a Reverb installed.
zh_steps: 选中源轨，在发送条点“新建发送”；选中新建的 Aux 返回轨，点“装混响”；调发送增益，回听湿声比例。
en_steps: Select the source track and click "Create send"; select the new Aux return and click "Install reverb"; adjust send gain and audition the wet balance.

name: device-rack-clipper-crusher
zh_caption: 设备机架里显示软削波器与比特碾碎两张卡片，参数为只读读数。
en_caption: The device rack shows soft clipper and bit crusher cards; parameters are read-only.
zh_steps: 选中一条带削波/碾碎的轨，按 F9 打开设备机架，核对两张卡的参数名与顺序（碾碎在削波之前）。
en_steps: Select a track with clipper/crusher, press F9, check the two cards' parameter names and order (crusher before clipper).

name: device-rack-tape
zh_caption: 设备机架里一条生成轨的设备卡显示磁带饱和与已识别参数读数；没有驱动/混合旋钮。
en_caption: A generated track's device card in the device rack shows tape saturation and recognized parameter readouts; there are no drive/mix knobs.
zh_steps: 选中一条带磁带级的鼓轨，按 F9 打开设备机架，核对 `tape_drive`/`tape_mix` 读数，确认无旋钮。
en_steps: Select a drum track with a tape stage, press F9, check the `tape_drive`/`tape_mix` readouts, and confirm there are no knobs.

name: control-room-mono-side
zh_caption: F4 监听控制室；DIM/MONO/SIDE 按钮可见，MONO 或 SIDE 处于点亮态。
en_caption: F4 control room; DIM/MONO/SIDE buttons are visible, with MONO or SIDE lit.
zh_steps: F4 打开控制室，点 MONO 再点 SIDE，截取按钮状态；关闭后恢复。
en_steps: Press F4, click MONO then SIDE, capture the button state, then restore.

name: device-rack-strip-width
zh_caption: F9 设备机架选中带通道条的轨；设备卡显示已识别参数摘要与曲线，没有宽度旋钮。
en_caption: F9 device rack with a channel-strip track selected; the card shows recognized parameter readouts and curves, with no width knob.
zh_steps: F9 打开设备机架，选中该轨，检查通道条卡片；若摘要含 `strip_width` 则一并截入。
en_steps: Press F9, select the track, inspect the channel-strip card; include `strip_width` in the capture if present.

name: mixer-pan-strip
zh_caption: 混音台选中一条轨，声相格显示 C 或 L50/R50；推子与声相值可见。
en_caption: The mixer strip has a track selected; the pan cell shows C or L50/R50 and the fader and pan values are visible.
zh_steps: 打开混音台，选中轨道，拖动声相格到居中/偏左/偏右，截取读数。
en_steps: Open the mixer, select a track, drag the pan cell to centre/left/right, and capture the readout.

name: automation-device-param
zh_caption: 设备机架里的 EQ 低架增益与对应的设备参数泳道，二者共用同一个槽位下标
en_caption: EQ low-shelf gain in the device rack and the matching device-parameter lane; both use the same slot index
zh_steps: 选中带 EQ 的轨道，F9 打开设备机架；展开对应 `eq_low_gain` 泳道，截图。
en_steps: Select a track with EQ, press F9; expand the matching `eq_low_gain` lane, capture.

name: automation-lane-overview
zh_caption: 编排视图展开多条自动化泳道，可见音量、声相与设备参数带及读/写角标
en_caption: Arrangement view with several automation lanes visible, including volume, pan and device-parameter bands with read/write badges
zh_steps: 先准备含音量、声相、设备参数泳道的工程，按 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+A 确认展开，截图。
en_steps: Prepare a project with volume, pan and device-parameter lanes; press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+A to confirm expansion, capture.

name: automation-point-edit
zh_caption: 在泳道带内点击后新增的自动化点，曲线与读/写角标同时可见
en_caption: A point added by clicking inside a lane band, with its curve and read/write badge visible
zh_steps: 在已存在的音量或声相泳道带内点击一次，确认出现点，截图。
en_steps: Click once inside an existing volume or pan lane band, confirm the point appears, capture.

name: bus-aux-send
zh_caption: 设备机架发送区显示一条到辅助返回轨的发送边，辅助返回轨的效果链与发送增益同屏
en_caption: Device rack send area showing a send edge to an auxiliary return, with the aux effect chain and send gain visible
zh_steps: 新建/选中一条辅助返回轨，在展示轨设备机架发送区点“新建发送”，截图。
en_steps: Create or select an auxiliary return; click "Create send" in the displayed track's device rack, capture.

name: export-wav-dialog
zh_caption: WAV 导出对话框：采样率、位深、时长、母线限制器开关与导出后的实测行
en_caption: WAV export dialog: sample rate, bit depth, duration, bus limiter switch, and the post-export measurement line
zh_steps: 文件菜单“导出音频 (WAV)...”打开对话框；如需实测行，先导出一次再截图。
en_steps: Open File > Export audio (WAV)...; export once first if the measurement line is needed, then capture.

name: master-bus-chain
zh_caption: 混音控制台选中主总线，主总线推子、电平表与设备机架插入链同屏
en_caption: Mixer console with the master bus selected, showing the master fader, meters and the master insert chain in the device rack
zh_steps: 按 F8 或 X 打开混音控制台，选中 Master；按 F9 打开设备机架，截图。
en_steps: Press F8 or X, select Master; press F9 to open the device rack, capture.

name: walkthrough-automation
zh_caption: 编曲区音量泳道有段落点，主唱轨与副歌边界可见
en_caption: Arrangement view with a volume lane and section points; lead-vocal track and chorus boundary visible
zh_steps: 按 A 展开自动化，点泳道加/改点，截图。
en_steps: Press A, click the lane to add or edit points, capture.

name: walkthrough-compressor
zh_caption: 压缩器行显示阈值、比率与 GR 文案；GR 文案不是实时表
en_caption: Compressor row showing threshold, ratio and the GR string; the GR string is not a live meter
zh_steps: 轨道菜单插 Compressor，点压缩器行循环比率，截图。
en_steps: Insert Compressor from the Track menu, click the row to cycle ratio, capture.

name: walkthrough-console
zh_caption: 混音控制台至少六条轨，推子、声像、轨道电平与主总线电平同屏
en_caption: Mixer console with at least six tracks; faders, pan, track meters and the master meter in one view
zh_steps: 按 X 或 F8 打开混音控制台，播放主歌一，截图。
en_steps: Press X or F8, play verse 1, capture.

name: walkthrough-eq-low
zh_caption: 设备机架 EQ 面板只显示低架增益滑块，频率与中高架不可见
en_caption: Device rack EQ panel showing only the low-shelf gain slider; frequency and mid/high bands are not visible
zh_steps: 选中主唱轨，装 EQ，拖动低架增益，截图。
en_steps: Select the lead vocal, insert EQ, drag the low-shelf gain, capture.

name: walkthrough-export
zh_caption: WAV 导出对话框的五个控件与导出后实测行同屏
en_caption: WAV export dialog with the five controls and the post-export measurement line in one view
zh_steps: 文件菜单导出 WAV，导出一次后截图。
en_steps: Export WAV from the File menu, export once, capture.
